text:
maria: Quick follow-up from the infra slides — thanks everyone for the walkthrough. Two quick asks: can we get a clear timeline for APAC pilot and a short note on what fallback looks like if a region hits supply limits? I want to feed both into customer comms.

sophia: APAC pilot target is end of Q3 for limited customers, full regional rollout depends on HW availability (we're seeing 6–10 week lead times right now). Fallback is policy-driven, not hard-fail — more below.

joel: By fallback, do you mean we route traffic to another region or to a different model variant? Curious how that affects latency SLOs.

sophia: Good q — fallback order today is: 1) compatible same-family model in other AZs in-region (if any spare capacity), 2) cross-region warm pool (within SLO budget), 3) quantized/low-memory variant in the same region as last resort. Latency impact: small bump for cross-region, larger for quantized variants. We'll document exact p95 deltas.

raj: For Dedicated customers with strict compliance, is cross-region fallback allowed? We had a legal ask about data residency during the demo.

sophia: Short answer: for Dedicated with region-pinning we won't cross-region without explicit customer opt-in. For multi-tenant Hosted customers we can failover as described. Action item: get Sales + Legal to confirm language for Dedicated contracts.

lisa: I'll publish a per-region capacity calendar and a procurement lead-time tracker by EOD Friday and link it here. Ownership: @lisa (capacity planning). Also creating #procurement-watch for live alerts.

capacity-bot: Capacity forecast updated for 2141-09-01 window.
```
region: availability_pct
US-West: 92%
US-East: 88%
EMEA: 65%
APAC: 40%
```

david: For autoscaler tuning: what's our guidance for warm pool sizes per pool? Right now some pools scale to zero and cold-starts spike p99.

sophia: Recommended starting points: small services 1-2 warm replicas, medium 3-5, high-throughput routes 8-12. We'll add an autoscaler cookbook to docs. Query for warm pool dashboard: `count_over_time(infra_warm_replicas[5m])` — can use in Grafana.

maria: Great — can we also get a 1-page FAQ for customers explaining APAC timeline + fallback behavior? Keep it non-technical, highlight SLAs. Raj + Sales to draft, infra to review.

raj: Will coordinate with Sales. Timeline: draft by next Tue, review Wed.

joel: Quick ops todo: publish runbook section that shows exact fallback order and measurable latencies. I'll PR it once Sophia gives numbers.

sophia: I'll add p50/p95 numbers to the runbook draft by Monday.

lisa: Owner checklist: - [x] publish calendar - [ ] create #procurement-watch - [ ] weekly sync invite (starting next Wed)

maria: Awesome — thanks all. Tiny ask: ping exec-comm when the FAQ is ready so we can update the customer-facing changelog. :thumbsup!
